Samantha — thanks and congrats on the green light. Draft plan below (high level) and I attached a one-page cutover playbook. I'll coordinate with infra to lock the exact GPU SKUs.

Summary proposal
- Target window: 2026-01-20 to 2026-01-22 (three days) — choose one primary cutover day and one fallback day.
- Fleet: 8 x a2-highmem-ish (equivalent to 8xA10g) for production pool; 2 x a2 for staging/canary.
- Throughput target: 850 req/s sustained (average payload), ~120k tokens/minute across the pool. Expected P95 token latency < 1.2s on quantized model variant.
- Alignment: We'll mirror your hosted model version v2025-11-quantiva and deploy the same tokenizer and prompt templates; we'll pin the model hash for the acceptance window.

Warmup & priming- Day -1: bulk prefix traffic replay (2 hours) to populate KV caches; synthetic priming followed by 10k production-like requests from your test key.
- Day 0 morning (canary): 1% production traffic routed; run through acceptance prompts and eval set (we'll compare log-likelihoods and regen diffs).

Acceptance criteria- Latency: P95 tokens within 1.5x of hosted baseline (baseline provided in rightsize report).
- Error rate: <0.5% HTTP 5xx and <1% model sanity failures (bad tokens/non-convergence).
- Quality checks: automated eval pass rate >= 95% on Quantiva prompt set.
- Cost sanity: tokens/sec and infra CPU/GPU utilization within expected bands (we'll provide counters).

Rollback triggers- Sustained P95 > 2x hosted for >15 minutes.
- Any data-plane error spike > 2% or any loss of KV cache integrity.
- Model output regression on blinded eval sample (auto-detected).

Operational notes- Autoscaling disabled for main pool during the handover (predictable capacity).
- We recommend a 2-hour canary at 5% after the 1% sanity window if initial checks pass.
- Logs and traces will be available in the shared GCS bucket and via the Redwood Console link below.

Next steps
1) Lauren will confirm the exact GPU SKU availability and provide a final nominal capacity/cost.
2) Quantiva infra to confirm the primary cutover date within 24 hours.
3) We'll run a tabletop run-through (1hr) with your SREs on Day -2.

I'm attaching the cutover playbook (quantiva-cutover-playbook.md) for the detailed step-by-step.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Account Lead, Redwood Inference
